name: Renown
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Medieval multiplayer survival and combat. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; export SteamAppId=1512690; exec ./Renown_Combat/Binaries/Linux/Renown_CombatServer-Linux-Shipping Renown_Combat -PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} -QUERYPORT={{QUERY_PORT}} -BeaconPort={{BEACON_PORT}} -RCONPort={{RCON_PORT}} -LOG=Server.log "-ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientId=xyza78917DzEE5Ey0isciVt66QDm5IzM" "-ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientSecret=m/mrnywFCdeA1mW3ZSvv3qcVlQlfwi1a+7Z63Q44EGU"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Renown. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 1512690) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and configs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1512690}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The Panel sets the server's settings in Game.ini and Engine.ini at every
# start; a Game.ini is written when there's none, and the rest of both files
# is the owner's.
cfg=Renown_Combat/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
mkdir -p "$cfg"
if [ ! -f "$cfg/Game.ini" ]; then
    cat > "$cfg/Game.ini" <<'EOF'
[/Game/Core/Blueprints/Renown_GameInstance.Renown_GameInstance_C]
bLAN=False
bAntiCheat=False
PrivateSession=False
GameDescription=Renown
RCONChatMessagesLimit=50

[/Game/Core/Blueprints/GameModes/Renown_Base_GameMode.Renown_Base_GameMode_C]
KickIdlePlayers=True
IdleTimeOutTime=300
EOF
    echo "Made Game.ini."
fi
touch "$cfg/Engine.ini"
echo "Installed Renown build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password that gives a player admin powers in game.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: True lists the server in the server browser; False hides it.

variables.name: Map rotation
variables.description: The maps the server plays in turn, separated by commas.

variables.name: Use first map
variables.description: True starts on the first map in the rotation.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: The save the server loads, or creates when there's none by that name.

variables.name: First person only
variables.description: Players can only use the first-person view.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Beacon port
variables.description: The port the server's beacon uses; give it an allocation.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: True turns on remote admin over RCON.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port RCON listens on; give it an allocation if you use it.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
